tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// zhal gdams snying gi nor bu'i 'khrul 'khor zin bris bzhugs so//

༄༅// sems skyil steng nas mi chen lugs// lus ni 'gyur med gegs sel bzhi// gan rkyal gcud 'bebs langs dgur ro// gtum mo'i 'dren 'grems 'khrul 'khor la// rdo rje nang 'dzin zla 'dzin dang*// khong 'dren dbang sdud nyi ma 'dzin// dwangs 'dzin dwangs ma rgyab lag brgyad// g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang mnyam mi mnyam// gom pa sa ga zlum po dang*// ru sbal bung ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs// ri bong 'degs pa bcu gcig 'dren// stod smad bar gyi rnam rol dang*// seng ge rtsal sprugs rtsangs pa'i brang*// sbal pa'i bgrad dang sbrul gyi 'khril// gnas lugs dwangs 'grems 'grems su bshad// dkar dmar 'ching dang seng ge'i log /stag mo'i gsum 'then gyad kyi bgrad// rma bya'i 'gying ba bzhi po 'dren// gegs rnams kun rdzogs kha bsgyur sel// nad brgya sman gcig khyad chos yin// dang po mi chen lugs ni/ sems skyil gyi steng nas bzhag sha brdabs te lag gnyis g.yas kyi thad nas phar brkyang*// tshur rdeb pa gsum// g.yon du gsum cha mnyam gsum// g.yon nu steng du bzhag /g.yas pas gsum/ bzlog ste gsum/ g.yas brkyang g.yon pas 'khru ba gsum/ bzlog ste gsum/ de nas lag mthil 'phur mgo stod kyi rgyab mdun 'phur ba gsum/ de nas cung zad tsog pus rkang pa g.yas pa mdun du lan gsum phra ste gsum/ de bzhin g.yon la'ang bya'o// lus mi 'gyur ba'i gegs sel bzhi'i dang po/ gan rkyal ni/ gan rkyal du nyal ba'i rkang pa gnyis nam mkhar shad brkyang ba'i sor mo bsnol bas sgyid khung nas 'then rgyab kyi tshigs thang sha gcod pa'o// bcud 'bebs ni/ lus gnad langs te khu tshur pus mgor bkan 'phongs dang sa'i bar du khru gang tsam bzhag dal bur phab tsho 'dzin lag pa ma gug par bya'o// langs pa ni/ har langs rkang pa gshibs lag pa steng du brkyang rgyab tu legs par dgyed pa'o// dgur ba ni/

rkang lag gi mthil bzhi sa la phab ste mgo bkug la dgur gyis sgal pa bsgong zhing 'chun 'dod pa'o// gtum mo'i 'dren 'grems kyi dang po/ rdo rje nang 'dzin ni pus btsugs khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ 'dren dus iṃ gi sgra phyir dal bus bus/ 'jam pos dwangs ma 'dren/ de nas lto ba bskor bas 'byed/ phyir 'bud ran tshad kyis zho 'dra ba 'dren/ lto ba bskor bas 'byed/ phyir 'bud drag pos snyigs ma dar ba 'dra ba 'dren/ steng du sgregs pa 'don/ lto ba bskor bas 'byed do// phyir 'bud pa shin tu drag po'i mthar thang sha bcad/ phyir 'dzin gyis khams sho mang gi tshi lta bu 'dren/ lto ba bskor bas 'byed/ rlung brngubs te smad du rdig /sor mos rgyu zhabs mnyes la snyigs ma 'bod do// rdo rje zla 'dzin ni/ pus btsugs khu tshur brla khugs su btsugs la hiṃ/ gzhan snga ma bzhin/ rdo rje khong 'dren ni/ pus btsugs brla g.yas kyi khar khu tshur g.yon/ de'i rgyab tu g.yas bsnol thabs su bzhag /gzhogs g.yas nas yar dal bu dal bus 'then te nam mkhar thang gis brkyang*/ de bzhin g.yon dbus su byed/ oṃ rdo rje dbang sdud ni/ pus btsugs khu tshur brla khugs su btsugs pa'i g.yas pa gyen du steng gi nam mkhar brkyang*/ de log pa dang g.yon la'ang byed/ hrī rdo rje dwangs 'dzin ni/ langs la khu tshur pus steng du bzhag /ha rdo rje dwangs 'dzin ni/ langs la rkang par mtho gang bzhag /rting pa sprad/ lag pa brla zur nas khu tshur gyis lag ngar gyis rtsib logs bzhar la/ steng gi nam mkhar thang gis 'then// hu rdo rje dwangs ma ni/ gnyis pa/ langs la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya pus mo'i thad du brgyangs pa dang lus sgur/ lus kyi dkyil thad nas phyag rgya 'debs pa dang ldang ba bstun spyi bor bkal/ hūṃ 'di'i mthar lus gnad gan rkyal du yan lag phyogs bzhir brgyangs/ mthar phaṭ ces brjod do// rdo rje rgyab lag ni/

langs te dal mo g.yas pa'i thad du khu tshur bsnol ba brgyangs gdong g.yas su gcu hab/ go bzlog la/ dbus su/ mthar 'phongs bsdigs kyis 'bebs pa dang phaṭ brjod/ dwangs ma zho 'dra dar ba sho mang gi tshi lta bu kun 'dra la/ long chung na mtha' ma kho nas so// dbang gsum pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'dren dang po/ g.yas brkyang ni/ g.yon pa'i rting pas gsang rtsa mnan/ khu tshur g.yon brla khugs g.yon du btsugs/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang ba/ lag g.yas steng gi nam mkhar 'then pa dang mnyam du/ g.yon brkyang ni de go bzlog go /mnyam pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis mdun du shad brkyang ba dang mnyam du lag pa khu tshur brang kha nas steng du 'then/ mi mnyam pa ni/ rkang pa g.yas dang lag pa g.yon brkyang zhing 'then pa/ de go bzlog nas byed pa/ rdo rje gom pa ni/ kha sbub tu brkyang ba'i rkang pa gnyis 'khril/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya thang gis brkyang ba dang mnyam du brang dgyed/ sa ga ni/ rkang rting sprad/ sgyid pa ldem byas kha tshur brla khugs su btsugs pa/ zlum po ni/ langs pa g.yon pa'i mtheb mo g.yas pa'i brang pas mnan/ lag pa gru mo gnyis la bsnol mar bzung ste/ mdun sgur byas gru mo bsnol ba spyi bo thang gis 'then/ ru sbal ni/ dgur ba'i pus steng du pho ba bzhag /lag pa khu tshur bcas pa'i lag ngar sa la phab/ mgo mdun nas khug byas pa/ bud pa ni/ kha sbub pa'i rkang pa la lag pas bzung*/ smad brang la ma reg par sbo thang gis brgyangs/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs ni/ kha sbub rkang brla la lag pas 'jus pa/ ri bong 'degs ni 'phongs sa la bzhag /rkang pa mdun du brkyang*/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur lag ngar gyis kha sked rtsib logs la yar drud cing khu tshur nu ma'i thad du sleb pa dang khu tshur kha sbubs nas nam mkhar thang 'then/ de nas rkang pa'i sor mo gnyis lag pas 'then te sgyid pa ma gug par bya'o// 'di thams cad la stong 'dren du byed na rlung dal bus 'bud pa dang bstun cing mthar phyir thang sha bcad cing 'dzin/

lto ba sgal pa la bcar/ mig gyen la bzlog /rna ba srang bya/ lce chung yar dkan la sbyar ro// sgang 'dren gyi tshe drub bzhud kyis gzhan 'dra'o// 'grems kyi 'khrul 'khor dang po/ stod smad bar gsum gyi rnam rol ni/ rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa'i sor mos sna mig rna ba kha mthe bong gis mgrin pa'i rba rlabs ltem/ rlung kha sbyor mgo la 'then zhing bzung nas mdun du khugs tshad bkug /yang rgyab tu dgyed/ rlung mi thub pa'i dus mgo dang lag pa mdun du sprug /rjes su rlung sangs 'bud pa gsum stod kyi rnam rol/ skyil krung lag gnyis bsnol bas mchan rtsa bsdam la/ sked pa g.yas g.yon du bskor/ mthar sil li li sprug pa bar gyi rnam rol/ skyil krung lag gnyis mkhal rtsa mnan nas skyil krung dang 'phongs re mos rdab/ mthar lus rdeb pa smad kyi rnam rol/ seng ge rtsal sprugs ni/ rkang sor sa la btsugs/ rting pa'i khar 'phongs bzhag /lag pas rba rlabs btsir/ zi thom byung ba dang lag pa steng du bsgyur ba dang 'phar zhing rdeb pa'o// rtsangs pa'i brang 'grems ni/ kha sbub pa'i rkang pa'i bar la khru gang yod pa mar brkyang*/ lag pa'i bar la'ang khru gang byas pa yar brkyang la mdun du gum me gum me 'gro bas 'chun 'don pa/ yang kha gyen la gtad nas rgyab kyis 'gro ba/ sbal pa'i bgrad 'grems ni/ kha sbub pa'i rkang lag phyogs bzhir brgyangs te brang sa la ma reg par mdun du khrud khrud gom pa gsum 'chun dang bcas pas phyin/ mthar rkang lag sa la ma reg par brang dang lto ba sa la rdeb pa'o// yang gan rkyal du phyin la rgyab tshigs sa la rdeb pa/ sbrul gyi 'khril 'grems ni/ lus bsgril te rkang lag bsgril te g.yas su bsgral/ de bzhin g.yon du'o// gnas lugs kyi dwangs 'grems ni/ mthar lus sems rgya yan du bzhag pa'o// de thams cad rlung bum pa can khegs rtsi ba/ de nas rang sa'i 'chun 'don pa'o// rdo rje nyi ma dbang sdud kyi skabs su/

dkar cha 'ching ba ni/ skyil krung bcas lag sor bsnol ma rlung phyir 'bud dang bstun nar gyis spyi bo'i nam mkhar lag pa gan rkyal du byas te thang gis 'then la g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du 'chun 'don/ de'i ring phyir 'dzin/ nang du rlung brngubs pa dang lag pa kha sbub log ste spyi bor lan gsum rdeb/ de nas mgrin pa/ snying ga /lte gsang rnams su sor mo bsnol ba sbyar te gru mo brgyangs nas sprug /yang gsang gnas nas bzlog ste spyi bo'i bar du sprug go /dmar cha 'ching ba ni/ tsog pu rkang pa bsnol/ pus mgo la lag pa bsnol mar dgab rlung rang 'gag gi ngang nas stod la 'then sprug rdeb lan gsum/ yang sems skyil byas/ rlung bzung rdo rje khu tshur lte bar rtse sprad la 'phur/ yang yar rtsib logs la bshud pa dang mnyam du rlung stod la 'then/ yang mar rdig pa dang bstun khu tshur mar bshud rgyu zhabs sngar bzhin 'phur ba lan gsum gyis rlung de shed bskyed la 'bud pa dang mnyam du lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gnam du bsgreng*/ phyi 'dzin ci thub byed/ mi thub pa dang rlung nang du brngub rdo rje khu tshur gyis lus mgo zhabs med par mnye'o// seng ge'i log 'then ni/ pus mo dang rkang ngar sa la btsugs pa'i bar mtho gsum tsam byas nas pus mo g.yon pa'i steng nas lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur brtsegs pa nar gyis rna ba g.yon pa'i steng du shed bskyed la 'then/ g.yas su gcu/ yang pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du phab la/ der shed bskyed nas 'phul ba lan gsum/ de bzhin g.yas/ cha mnyam du pus steng so so/ rna ba so sor 'degs so// stag mo'i gsum 'then ni/ rkang mgo bsnol ba'i g.yas pa'i mtheb chen nas lag pa bsnol bas bzung*/ g.yon g.yas su gcu zhing 'then/ dbus su 'then/ gyad kyi bgrad 'dren ni/ sems skyil khu tshur rdo rje'i mdun du rgyab sprad pas btsugs lag pa shed bskyed la brgyangs/

de nas mdun du 'phul ci thub byas te rim pas steng du khyer dus rna ba g.yas g.yon du gru mo sleb pas khu tshur kha gyen nas dpral bar brgyangs/ rma bya'i 'gying 'dren ni/ 'phongs sa la bzhag /rkang pa khug byas pa'i sgyid nang nas lag pa rdo rje khu tshur phyi la bton te btsugs/ lus g.yas 'then g.yon 'then dbus 'then pa/ de thams cad la rlung phyir 'bud dgu byas brngubs te dru bzhud kyi rlung gnad bya'o// gegs rnams kun rdzogs kha bsgyur sel/ zhes pa/ dri chen dri chu dang mnyam du khams 'dzag pa'am/ rang bzhin gyis 'dzag pa gang la'ang*/ kun rdzogs rgyag dus rkang pa bsnol te rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya pho ba dang phyir 'bud pa dang sbrags spyi bor 'then/ g.yas su kyog byas phyir 'dzin gyi ngang nas 'bebs pa g.yas su/ mkhal khung gnyis ka 'then byas dbus so// thams cad la dbang po gyen la bzlog /dmigs pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur te me 'bar bas rtsa gsum gyi mdo nas khams dbu mar ded de spyi bor bskyal bar bsam/ yang rgyu ma mkhal khung sems gzer zhing na ba/ dri ma gnyis bsdam pa/ pho ba sbos pa/ brla na ba sogs la kun rdzogs kyi lag pa log dus mkhal ma ma gtogs gang na sar brdeg /dri chu bsdam pa la de dus rgya sug mar dang bsres pa ran tsam bshad par byug /mkhal ma la log dus mkhal ma bzho/ stod nad thams cad ha 'don dang bstun pas sel lo/ de lta bu'i 'khrul 'khor la 'grangs ltogs drag pa dang*/ ha cang nyi ma tsha ba/ du ba yod pa rnams spang*/ rtsam dul ring 'khrul 'khor gtso/ de nas dbu mar tshud kyi bar rlung gtso/ de nas dbu mar gnas pa la sems gtso'o// pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /sarba maṅgalaṃ//
